concept.setting: a human market town in green rolling farmland under a soft gold sky
concept.buildings: heavy dark timber frames over cream plaster on thick grey stone ground storeys, jettied upper floors bulging over the street, steep oversized red-brown tile roofs with deep eaves, chunky brick chimneys, round-topped doors, flower boxes
concept.landmark: a stout grey stone abbey church with a square bell tower and a huge slate spire on a rise over the town
concept.street_life: a market cross with striped stalls, hanging trade signs, carts of hay and barrels, washing lines across lanes, a well at the junction, lamp posts
concept.greenery: big round oaks, hedged fields and orchards, ivy on the oldest walls, a village green
concept.materials: dark oak and spruce timber, calcite plaster, stone bricks and cobblestone, granite tile roofs, bricks
